description: The Talatal Ghar is an 18th-century palace-fortress in Sivasagar, Assam, and stands as the largest architectural monument built during the Ahom dynasty. Originally commissioned as a military base by King Rudra Singha around 1707
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
